premise.stated: 26 literal state-paint sites wire to the governed states channels, byte-equal at rest in all three verticals
premise.measured: FALSE as stated, and the correction runs in the lot's favour. Of the 26, SIX paint the governed channels already and were blocked by REACH (a pseudo on a part compound, a prop echo the part law refuses, an adapter contract with no stamp) — those wire byte-equal. TWO carry a flat family ring channel and wire with a declared change. The other EIGHTEEN carry no governed non-chromatic lever on a measured node at all: giving them one is new paint, a reviewed visual decision, not wiring. A seventh byte-equal wire comes from the pseudo-only list (collection-workspace-render-dispatch), whose nine siblings stay residual.

fleet.otherAxes: byte-identical movedIds on shape/typography/rhythm/depth/motion; all negative-control cells 0
fleet.note: badge and edit-header are gains this lot did not target: badge reads --ds-filter-pill-focus-ring, and edit-header shares the back chip that header-hero-shared declares.

restAB.method: the composed bundle, and the same bundle with exactly this lot's declarations textually restored, mounted in one page per vertical/mode
restAB.allDifferencesUnder: the focus-visible stamp only — zero at rest, zero under hovered/pressed/selected/disabled

declaredChanges.paint: the tag close button's keyboard ring becomes the tenant's ring (two layers: bg offset + colour) instead of a 2px currentColor halo, in all three verticals and both modes
declaredChanges.precedent: --ds-tag-focus-ring and --ds-header-back-focus-ring already state their rings this way

declaredChanges.paint: the pill's and the badge's keyboard rings become the tenant's ring; measured on badge in all three verticals and both modes. list-toolbar reads the same channel and follows.
declaredChanges.precedent: as above; a tenant's chrome.filterPill.focusRing still outranks it

activity-cards.detail: the view-all ring already read --ds-focus-ring-width/-offset; the rule was `:focus-visible` alone and the shared NavLinkAnchor now stamps the kernel token
activity-cards.byteEqual: at rest and under hovered/pressed/selected/disabled; under a keyboard focus the same declaration at the same specificity

activity-ticker.detail: the view-all anchor plus its own nav-button and ticker-dot controls, all three already governed

collection-workspace-render-dispatch.detail: the fallback card's open link: the ring already read the governed channels, the bare anchor stamped nothing

header-hero-shared.detail: the back chip's ring rides --ds-header-back-focus-ring, already a var(--ds-focus-ring, ...) product; the focusable node is the app-injected anchor and NavigationLinkProps admitted no stamp. The contract now carries one, both headers forward the anchor's focus onto the chip's own data-state, and `a:focus-visible` stays as the platform arm

slider.detail: rail/track/handle/dot/tooltip already read --ds-state-disabled-opacity; every rule was headed by [data-disabled='true'] alone, which the part law refuses, so the parts were never mounted for the states axis. The head pairs the kernel token with the prop echo and the root stamps both
slider.byteEqual: every measured cell, in every state: neither attribute was removed and no value changed

tag.detail: --ds-tag-close-focus-ring was the one flat ring in a file whose sibling --ds-tag-focus-ring is already a var(--ds-focus-ring, ...) product; it now states its ring the same way

status-filter-pills.detail: --ds-filter-pill-focus-ring's :root default was a flat 3px halo; it now reads var(--ds-focus-ring, <the literal>). chrome.filterPill.focusRing still outranks both

active-filters-bar.detail: no state rule of this family writes transform/opacity/outline/box-shadow/border-width at all

card-compounds.detail: its only state rule is headed by `.ds-card[data-interactive]`, another family's root; refused as head-not-the-family-root. Its values (--ds-card-header-icon-lift/-shadow-hover) are not states channels either

collection-header.detail: quick-actions paints translateY(-1px) under BOTH hover and press (the press arm is a copy of the hover arm). There is no press scale to wire; giving it one is new paint, a reviewed visual decision

collection-workspace.detail: the page-size-control hover/focus-within box-shadows are bespoke literals; wiring the focus-within shadow to --ds-focus-ring is a geometry change on a surface with no ring vocabulary of its own

decision-comparison.detail: the fact row's hover inset shadow is a colour-mix literal on no states channel

descriptions.detail: the row hover/press transforms and inset shadows are literals; the family declares no focus ring and no press scale on a measured node

field-filters-panel.detail: it DECLARES --ds-button-focus-ring from --ds-focus-ring-width, but the ring is painted inside a composed Button, which is not a measured node of this family

float-button.detail: its state rules are headed by [data-part='trigger'], not the mounted [data-part='root']; the values ride --ds-button-* channels, not the states roots

input-compounds.detail: every state rule is headed by `.ds-input-textarea`, a different root from the mounted `.ds-input-addon`

metrics-minimal.detail: hover scale(1.05) and chevron reveal are literals; there is no governed hover-scale channel (--ds-state-hover-shift is colour)

notification-center.detail: mark-read/dismiss opacity:1 is a reveal, not a disabled muting; nothing on this family reads a states root

operational-ledger.detail: no state rule writes a non-chromatic longhand

presence.detail: the avatar hover lift reads --ds-motion-offset-in, a motion channel; the states arms do not move it

record-facts.detail: no state rule writes a non-chromatic longhand

scope-switcher.detail: no state rule writes a non-chromatic longhand

search-command-bar.detail: as field-filters-panel: it declares --ds-button-focus-ring from the governed roots, and the composed Button paints it

stats-grid.detail: the card's focus ring IS governed but its rule is `.ds-stats-grid__card[data-interactive="true"]`; the part law refuses any part attribute but data-part. Dropping the gate would be a selector generalisation, not a wire

visual-excellence-preview.detail: showcase-only chrome; its focus/hover shadows are bespoke literals on no channel

activity-log.detail: as stats-grid: the item-body ring is governed but gated on [data-interactive='true']

anchor.detail: twinning every pseudo still lands no state rule on the mounted node

search.detail: its one reachable state rule paints border-radius on [data-state], a shape read, not a states one

tooltip.detail: its bubble is headed by its own root class; refused as head-not-the-family-root (the standing portal limit)
